name: carrying on as renewed work, begun before the close
what_it_changes: P13 says that near the close and after it the room decides what of its effort to keep. In these rooms carrying on is work in its own right, and it starts while placement is live: on another canvas the room recruits, builds and defends again, members remake the work in other media, and the mark is adopted into the room before the close.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-step_P13_T4-028.txt, state one shared change to P13. R1a: T3-054 (carrying work to new canvases) holds 22 of the 43 rooms, T3-057 9 and T3-156 7, so the branch is declared at the fourth order. 'Continuation after the original closure includes renewed recruitment, building, coordinates, and design adjustment on replacement canvases' (gravityfalls); 'Remaking in another medium begins while the original canvas remains live' (prequelmemes). These are the labelers' how sentences.
